name: t2_pairwise_pool_top1_diag_20260620
purpose: T2 model-only Top1 improvement experiment using a pairwise reranker inside a selector-union pool. This is not promoted as runtime default because fresh100t was used for diagnostic selection.

primary_extra_d8_t075.decision: Fails EV-safety on fresh100v: Top1 improves but Reg1 is worse than default.

secondary_bpw5_hgb_l15_t030.decision: Best predeclared gate on fresh100v: improves both Top1 and Reg1 versus default.

pairwise_pool5_bpw5_gw15_always.decision: Best fresh100w external result: improves both Top1 and Reg1 versus default, but remains diagnostic because pool5 can still leak.

secondary_bpw5_hgb_l15_t030.decision: Confirms a conservative EV improvement on fresh100w, but underuses the stronger pairwise signal.

selector_top_chooser.decision: Choosing among existing model Top1 actions has only a 60% oracle ceiling on fresh100x, and learned choosers do not beat the default Top1. This means Top1 improvement needs better candidate-level scoring, not only a top-action switch gate.

selector_feature_ranker_gmtuvw.decision: This is the first repeated external Top1 lift over default after the pairwise/gate failure: fresh100x 50% to 54%, and the predeclared x-best model on fresh100y 39% to 42%. The direction is confirmed but not runtime-safe because Top10/Reg10 can regress; keep diagnostic and mine remaining high-EV-loss misses.

top1_hard_negative_x_eval_y.decision: Hard-negative Top1 weighting from fresh100x generalizes strongly to fresh100y and fresh100z. On fresh100y it improves 39% to 65% and cuts Reg1 from 1.141 to 0.626; on fresh100z the x-only model reaches 77% Top1 and 0.311 Reg1, while the xy-hard model reaches 80% Top1 and 0.305 Reg1. This is now a strong Top1 source candidate, but not a complete standalone policy because small TopK coverage can still regress. Keep Top15/Top20 plus exact rerank as the accuracy backstop; next step is a larger untouched shard and then promotion only if the Top1 lift and Top15 zero-loss profile persist.

fresh100x_holdout_eval.decision: Fresh100x rejects promotion of the fresh100w-selected pairwise Top1 improvements. A new candidate-level selector-feature ranker trained on fresh100g/m/t/u/v/w improves fresh100x Top1 to 54%, and its predeclared x-best model also improves fresh100y Top1 from 39% to 42%. This confirms a weak Top1 direction, but it is still diagnostic because Top10/Reg10 can regress.

ev_safe_switch_gate.decision: The switch gate fixes the main fresh100u weakness of pairwise-only selection: Top1 improves from 54% to 59% and Reg1 improves from 0.923 to 0.878. Keep diagnostic because the gate model and threshold were selected after inspecting fresh100u; freeze this gate and validate on a new untouched fresh100v before promotion.

fresh100aa_top1_pool_arbitrator_eval.decision: Adding fresh100z hard negatives directly did not improve external fresh100aa Top1; xyzw50gap fell behind xyhard. The better direction is a learned selector-Top1 pool arbitrator: it improves fresh100aa Top1 from the best single selector 80% to 83%, with Top10 reaching 100%. Keep diagnostic until the arbitrator is validated on another untouched shard and its remaining high-EV-loss misses are mined.

fresh100ab_external_followup.decision: Fresh100ab confirms the best single selector is external but around 80%, not 99%: xyhard is 79% Top1 here after 80% on fresh100aa. The selector Top1-pool oracle ceiling drops to 85%, so the pool itself limits any learned Top1 arbitrator on this shard. Accuracy backstop remains strong: Top10 union plus exact rerank is 99% with max EV loss 0.187, and Top20 union plus exact rerank is 100% with zero measured cap50 EV loss.

fresh100ac_external_confirmation.decision: Fresh100ac confirms the same broad conclusion on a harder untouched shard: model-only/pool-reranker Top1 is about 84%, not near 99%. Accuracy-first exact rerank is much stronger: Top10 union misses 1/100 with max EV loss 0.887, while Top12/Top20 union exact rerank has zero measured cap50 EV loss. Since the 5s target is only a rough guide, keep Top12-Top15 exact-rerank as the accuracy backstop while mining the remaining high-EV-loss misses.

rejected_pool3_ac_missweighted.decision: reject because Top1 gain worsens Reg1 versus old_pool3

fresh100ac_retraining_and_fresh50ad_exte.decision: The only clean improvement from this pass is the Top1-pool arbitrator trained with fresh100ac and no miss over-weighting. It improves fresh50ad Top1 from 78% to 80% and Reg1 from 0.188 to 0.181 versus the old Top1-pool, while matching old pool3 Top1/Reg1 with a much smaller pool. This is a small external improvement, not a solution; model-only Top1 remains far below 99%.

decision: Model-only T2 Top1 has improved into the high-80s/low-90s on some clean shards, but fresh50ae/fresh50af and the disagreement-weighted retrain show that neither blind shard appending nor simple overweighting is sufficient. Current diagnostic best remains pool3 extra_gap_d14 at 92% Top1 and Reg1 0.062 on fresh50af. Next work should generate more exact-labeled cases matching the 49 mined disagreement/high-loss patterns, then retrain and validate on untouched shards.

fresh50ae_external_check.decision: Fresh50ae does not confirm a general Top1 model improvement from adding fresh100ac/fresh50ad: Top1 stays 88%. Do not promote the new Top1-pool model yet. Accuracy-first Top10 union plus exact rerank is confirmed on this untouched shard with 100% recall and zero measured cap50 EV loss, avg pool 13.30 and max pool 17.

fresh50af_external_after_ae.decision: Fresh50af rejects blind promotion of adding fresh50ae: Top1-pool stays 90% and pool3 with ac/ad/ae regresses to 90%. The useful diagnostic candidate is pool3 extra_gap_d14: same Top1 as old pool3 at 92% but lower Reg1 0.062. Oracle switching with hgb_cls_l31 could reach 94%, but learned gates did not improve because positive switch examples are too rare in current training data.

w8t12.decision: reject because no Top1 lift and fresh50ae EV loss worsens

pool3_disagreement_mining_20260621.decision: The miner found useful hard cases, but directly overweighting 49 existing rows does not improve external Top1 and worsens fresh50ae Reg1. Keep the miner and generate more similar cases; do not promote weighted models.

targeted_source_mining_pipeline_20260621.purpose: Generate many cheap T2 source rows, score them with existing pool models, exact only high-signal rows, then retrain Top1 selectors on exact labels.

targeted_top50_retrains.decision: No external Top1 lift from the 50-row targeted exact shard. Keep as diagnostic data; scale the same targeted pipeline to more exact rows before trying to promote a model.

fresh1000ah_targeted_exact.decision: The exact labels are real and high-signal, but hard-only append training did not improve untouched external Top1. Keep this as diagnostic data and train future models on a balanced broad exact plus targeted exact mixture.

lgbm_ranker.decision: Reject. LightGBM lambdarank did not improve external Top1 or Reg1.

extended_ah200_top1_weighted.decision: reject because Top1 fell below the extended-clean and extended-ah200 models

extended_top1_oracle_switch.decision: No useful switch-gate headroom: extended models still choose almost the same Top1 actions.

ak80_plus_synthetic_ae_like40.decision: reject; targeted synthetic rows overfit and hurt external Top1

new_variant_oracle.decision: No useful switch/gate headroom. New variants did not hit the remaining large-loss external groups.

targeted_ak80_synthetic_20260621.decision: Do not promote these targeted models. The new hard labels are valid, but the current feature-pool scorer did not improve external model-only Top1.

poollocal_top1_oracle_switch.decision: No useful switch/gate headroom. Base, pool-local, ak80 pool-local, and pairwise variants still choose almost the same Top1 actions.

board_context_dim789_direct_nn.decision: reject; richer board/deck context features did not make the direct NN a usable external Top1 scorer

old_selectors_dim789_fixedadapt.base_scores_source: copied from matching dim693 shards after verifying scores/group_ids/action_indices ordering

train_selected_blend.decision: train-selected fixed blends did not beat the existing 91% external Top1

old_l31_vs_new789_poollocal_l31.selection: fit on 80% train groups; threshold selected on 20% train dev

old_l31_vs_old_l63.selection: fit on 80% train groups; threshold selected on 20% train dev
old_l31_vs_old_l63.decision: reject for Top1; useful only as EV-loss tail diagnostic

old_selectors_dim789_fixedadapt.decision: reject for Top1; preserving old selector sources and adding dim789 board/deck context to the final HGB reranker matches but does not beat the current external best

code_changes: ai/training/action_feature_encoding.py: add optional board/deck context feature vector for state_dim 789
ai/training/convert_action_value_teacher.py: record board context feature dim in metadata
ai/training/merge_action_value_reranker_data.py: allow missing base_scores.npy when merging converted data
ai/training/train_t2_selector_feature_ranker.py: adapt older sklearn models to newer state vectors by preserving runtime base/rank suffix features
ai/training/evaluate_t2_selector_feature_union.py: preserve selector features when adapting feature-selector inputs
ai/training/train_t2_pairwise_pool_reranker.py: adapt feature-selector inputs with predict_adapted for mixed 693/789 state vectors
pool_local_and_attention_20260621.decision: Pool-local features slightly improve Reg1 with ak80 but do not lift external model-only Top1 above 91%. Attention is worse. Board/deck context direct NN is worse, and old-selector dim789 reranking only matches 91%. Do not promote.

neural_and_extended_data_20260621.decision: Broad clean exact data improved external model-only Top1 from 90% to 91%. The ah200 targeted rows reduced Reg1 but did not add another Top1 point. Neural direct rerankers were worse.

selector_full_gap002_best4.decision: reject for model-only Top1; pairwise fixes Top10 rerank coverage but does not add external Top1 hits over the existing 91% baseline

both_diff_gap010_best6_l31.decision: reject; adding state features to pairwise diff made external Top1 worse

extended_pairwise_pool10_20260621.decision: No promotion. The exact best remains inside the pool10 union on fresh50ae/fresh50af, but pairwise objectives still choose the same wrong Top1 families. The next Top1 work should add new balanced exact coverage or a materially different representation/objective.

top1_miss_weighting_20260621.purpose: Improve model-only T2 Top1 by mining high-EV-loss Top1 misses and adding hard-miss feature selectors as pool sources.

external_fresh10al_clean.note: Pipeline proof only; too small/easy for promotion evidence.

fresh30am_an_miss5_candidate.decision: Not preferred. It slightly improves ae/af/nop aggregate Top1, but loses the fresh30ao Top3=100% result that the miss2 candidate has.

w12_t24_min005.decision: Diagnostic only. It improves the trained BTN second100 shard from Top1 85% to 91%, but held-out aggregate is effectively flat and fresh200ai_first100 Top3 drops to 98%.

w24_t48_min0.decision: Rejected. Stronger weights do not improve held-out Top1 and add more Top3/Top10 side effects.

followup_miss_retraining_20260621.decision: The fresh30am_ao_miss4 candidate remains the preferred diagnostic model, but fresh200ai second100 shows a BTN weakness: Top1 85.0%, Top3 88.0%, Top10 92.0%. A one-root BTN hard-negative retrain fixes the trained shard but does not improve held-out aggregate, so the next improvement needs broader multi-root BTN exact coverage rather than promoting this retrain.

top1_miss_weighting_20260621.decision: Promising but still diagnostic. The fresh30am_ao_miss4 model is strong on BB fresh200ai first100 but weak on BTN fresh200ai second100. BTN hard-negative retraining improved the trained BTN shard, not clean held-out aggregate, so there is not enough evidence to promote a new runtime default.
top1_miss_weighting_20260621.next_step: Generate and exact-check broader multi-root BTN T2 coverage, then retrain with balanced BB/BTN hard negatives and validate on untouched mixed-position shards.

pool10_selection_diagnostics_20260621.decision: On the checked external shards, the exact best action is inside pool10, but current scoring models cannot reliably choose it as Top1. Model-only Top1 is now 91% with the extended clean/ah200 training pass; pool10 plus exact rerank remains the reliable path.

targeted_source_mining_pipeline_20260621.decision: The source preselection path is mechanically valid. It generated real hard exact labels, but external model-only Top1 is not improved yet. The current bottleneck is candidate scoring inside a pool that already contains the exact best action.

fresh100aj_only_w12_t24.decision: Rejected as a general improvement. It improves the trained fresh100aj shard but worsens the existing BTN second100 external check.

second100_plus_fresh100aj_w12_t24.decision: Diagnostic only. Hard shards improve, but the clean held-out aggregate is below the previous second100-only hard-negative candidate.

second100_plus_fresh100aj_plus_ak80_hgb_.decision: Diagnostic only. It reduces hard-shard EV loss, but it does not clearly beat the earlier second100-only candidate for model-only Top1.

ranker_same_data.decision: Rejected for Top1. Ranker lowers some EV-loss tails and makes fresh100aj traincheck perfect, but it does not improve model-only Top1 over the HGB candidates and hurts some Top3 checks.

oracle_and_blend.blend_result: Simple per-group z-score blends with the MLP improve hard trainchecks but do not lift clean Top1 above the best tree model.

neural_pool_scorer_probe.decision: No promotion. Neural scorers improve trained hard shards, but clean held-out Top1 remains around 95-96%, and oracle switching shows almost no independent Top1 choices. The remaining misses require new information in the features/data, not just a different scorer on the same selector pool.

multi_root_btn_and_hardneg_followup_2026.decision: No runtime promotion. Broader multi-root BTN data fixed the one-root concern and showed Top10 can be clean on fresh100aj, but model-only Top1 still does not generalize enough. The next Top1 step should be a larger, balanced hard-shard exact set or a stronger EV scorer/representation, not more small miss-weight tuning.
